options: The model, inside the provider’s servers
The harness or application, after the model requests it
explain: The model only emits a request with arguments. Your code runs the tool, with your permissions and checks.

q: Which change to a tool definition most reduces wrong-tool errors when many tools are loaded?
options: Specific names and descriptions that say when to use the tool and how it differs from similar ones
explain: The model chooses tools from their names and descriptions; ambiguity between overlapping tools is the top cause of wrong picks.

q: A tool returns 30,000 tokens of log output. What is the better design?
options: Return it all; models have long context
Truncate or paginate in the harness, say what was cut, and let the model ask for more
explain: Large results crowd the context and degrade later steps. Bound results and make truncation visible.
